joystickRangePixels._comment: Maximum visual thumb displacement in CSS pixels; full speed begins at joystickFullSpeedFraction of this radius.

tapMovementPixels._comment: Movement beyond this distance cancels tap recognition; movement input itself has no dead zone.

doubleTapDistancePixels._comment: Maximum distance between the two taps of a bark gesture.

doubleTapMs._comment: Maximum elapsed time between taps of a bark gesture.

compatibilityClickMs._comment: Suppress the click generated after a touch bark for this interval.

joystickFullSpeedFraction._comment: Fraction of joystick radius at which movement reaches maximum speed; outer 15% remains at maximum.

joystickLogStrength._comment: Positive logarithmic speed curvature: log1p(strength * normalized travel) / log1p(strength).

maxDeltaSeconds._comment: Variable simulation frame-step cap; keep physics-sensitive changes under regression review.

barkVibrationMs._comment: Device vibration duration when Pip barks.

modalFocusDelayMs._comment: Delay before focusing the first button in an opened modal.

urgentCountdownSeconds._comment: Delivery time remaining at which the countdown becomes urgent.

cycleSeconds._comment: Dwell time for manually shown or later automatic tips.

initialSeconds._comment: Dwell time of the first automatic tutorial tip.
